note: Illinois DNR fish and wildlife area on the Illinois River backwaters between Canton and Banner (US 24). Graveled back-in electric sites close together beside the highway and rail line, plus primitive tent and trailer sites; busy in duck season. Low-lying area: roads and facilities can close in floods, so call ahead. --Claude
